seat_baseline_about: The Claude models a seat session may call when a Workspace names none (agent_gateway/seat_policy_keys.BASELINE_SEAT_MODELS): these, every installation_defaults model above and the reviewer's claude_code default in agent_gateway/review_models.json. One source: the reviewer default claude-sonnet-5-5 was missing from a second, hard-coded list, so every fresh installation with a seat paused review_no_decision (seat_model_not_allowed).

source_labels.run_start: the model chosen at run start
source_labels.thread: the model chosen on the run's thread
